baseline.model: Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct + phase4-miyuki-0.2 LoRA (120 ex, assistant-only, 39 steps)
baseline.note: Phase 4 is the quality reference until a Phase 5 experiment proves otherwise.

character_voice.evidence: P1-P3: interchangeable voices (Sister/Bret, Aunt Mary). P4: Jinx still earnest (109 toks mission-speak). P4C: Jinx in-voice dry/blunt (discard->edit) but content drifts surreal. 1.5B base: best Jinx yet (41-tok witty) but multi-character scenes still collapse.

personality_consistency.evidence: Jinx witty/blunt requirement failed P1-P4 (earnest/formal opposite). P4C improved single-scene voice but multi-character scenes collapse to generic.

emotional_behavior.evidence: P1-P3: tells emotion ('heart pounding', 'relief wash'). P3B: showed via body (held between teeth, swallow thickly - P4C lost this keep). P4: body action present but letter-empty confusing.

character_specific_vocabulary.evidence: No phase produced distinct diction per character in eval; training examples (002, 041, 043, 076) demonstrate it but 4C eval shows collapsed voices in multi-character.

character_knowledge_boundaries.evidence: P4C hallucinates 'junior year', 'two people by fire', 'mom made it' - model states facts outside character knowledge.

character_reactions.evidence: 043/076 training examples teach distinct reactions; P4C dialogue shows some differentiation but eval not conclusively improved.

relationships.evidence: Mentor/student power dynamic improved P3B->P4; sibling roles improved P4C (eldest/mom kept).

distinct_voices.evidence: All phases: dialogue prompts scored 1-2. P4C improved roles but voices still collapse. 24-33 dialogue training examples not sufficient.

conversational_rhythm.evidence: No interruptions produced in eval despite training examples (018, 041).

subtext.evidence: quiet-scene-01 failed P1-P3 (meta/ticket). P4 first success (bench/whispers). P4C held. exp-subtext-01 still fails both P4 and P4C (dinner talk not leaving/staying debate).

silence.evidence: P4/P4C quiet-scene-01 PASS (silence carries weight, no meta).

natural_responses.evidence: P4C 'I'm not thirsty, just tired' natural; still some robotic replies.

multi_character_scenes.evidence: All multi-character evals collapse: P4C exp-dialogue-02 'camera' invented, exp-character-voice-01 Jinx soft.

avoiding_narrator_like_dialogue.evidence: P4-P4C: no essay-style dialogue in original suite (vs P1-P3 dumps).

exact_facts.evidence: context-retention-01 failed ALL phases: no chipped-blue mug, no lavender hate. P4C targeted 'cold, hard black from the fridge' hallucination.

binary_facts.evidence: Blue/lavender, mug/phone, station/market - all failed through 4C. 20+ binary training examples not learned.

object_identity.evidence: 1.5B hallucinated silver/black mug; P4C 'cold hard black from fridge'.

color.evidence: Blue scarf respected in some continuations (P4C exp-continuity-01) but blue mug never used.

ownership.evidence: Grandmother's mug never attributed correctly in eval.

previous_actions.evidence: P4C exp-continuity-01: 'scarf still missing... didn't put it on because he knew' - respects prior action.

chronology.evidence: exp-transitions tests 3-day skip; P4C learned mug-ring but labels 'Three days later'.

negative_facts.evidence: 'hates lavender', 'never drinks coffee from anything else' - negative constraints never obeyed in eval.

do_not_change_x_constraints.evidence: No-dialogue constraint: P4/P4C respected in description (vs P3B violation). Fact constraints still fail.

first_person.evidence: No eval prompt isolates 1st-person; training 150 exists.

third_limited.evidence: P4C: hallucinates facts outside limited viewpoint (junior year, two people).

child_viewpoint.evidence: description-01 failed all phases: adult summary, not child-anchored. P4 keep (backpack-27) was closest; P4C regressed to adult.

restricted_knowledge.evidence: Model states omniscient facts; training 150/151 teach limited but eval fails.

sensory_grounding.evidence: P4-P4C: selective grounded details (damp teacup, lantern/stream) vs P1-P3 purple.

object_retrieval.evidence: action-scene-01 failed all phases: notebook never retrieved. P4C targeted: notebook ends with vendor.

spatial_relationships.evidence: P1: school/security incoherent; P4C: vague light/paper-sleeve.

action_sequencing.evidence: Cause-effect chains broken in all action evals.

cause_effect.evidence: Training 080/097 teach readable chains; P4 action partially tracks (bag thud) but retrieval fails.

physical_continuity.evidence: P4C: 'light flickered... paper on sleeve' disjointed.

character_positioning.evidence: 1.5B: vendor grabs protagonist; P4C: notebook with vendor.

description.evidence: P4 keep (damp teacup) vs P1 purple raindrops. P4C comparable but less POV.

imagery.evidence: P4C surreal: 'window glass hard then soft', 'thumb no finger', 'old woman stopped because door creaked' - new failure mode from overfitting (train 0.25 vs eval plateau 2.86).

pacing.evidence: P4 quiet/scene pacing good; action pacing still fails.

sentence_variation.evidence: P4C 0 short-EOS in original; varied rhythm in keeps.

paragraph_rhythm.evidence: P4 paragraphs lead into each other; P4C surreal breaks.

emotional_writing.evidence: P3B keep (body action) lost in P4C; P4 edit-level; surreal regressions.

quiet_scenes.evidence: P4/P4C quiet-scene-01 PASS (first real quiet success).

transitions.evidence: P4C learned mug-ring (dataset 055/115); P4 used objects too.

rewriting.evidence: P4 keep (bed/hands/glasses/click 100 toks) - best. P4C regressed (29 toks, less vivid). exp-rewriting still short in both.

continuation.evidence: P4/P4C: proper continuation, no restart/summary (vs P1-P3 meta).

style_constraints.evidence: Tone kept P4/P4C; no-adjectives constraint (constrained-desc) still fails.

forbidden_details.evidence: No-dialogue respected; no-violence still violated (P4C targeted vendor grab).

formatting.evidence: Dialogue format produced in all phases.

tone.evidence: tone-consistency-01: P4/P4C perform restrained continuation, no essay (vs P1-P3 meta).

meta_commentary.evidence: P4-P4C: 0 meta flags (answer-is, tone-essay, announcements) in original+expanded vs P1 4 meta.

certainly.evidence: 0 in original suite all phases; 1.5B base had 1 ('Certainly! Here's your sentence').

explaining_instead_of_writing.evidence: P4-P4C write scenes when asked (vs P1-P3 analysis).

generic_ai_phrases.evidence: P1: 'wind of history', 'mix of excitement'. P4: less purple. Still some generic ('air thick with old books').

hedging.evidence: P4-P4C: 0 hedging essays (could-be/depends) vs P1 context essay.

premature_endings.evidence: P4/P4C: 0 short-EOS in original (vs P1 4 truncated). Expanded still has short outputs.

hallucinated_context.evidence: P4C: 'junior year', 'two people by fire', 'mom made it'; 1.5B: silver mug.

surreal_incoherent_imagery.evidence: NEW failure mode in P4C (overfitting): 4 prompts with surreal imagery.

unnecessary_moralizing.evidence: No 'And so they learned' in P4-P4C.

surviving_failures_priority.dataset_response: 0.3 B-target 8 examples not learned at 3 epochs
0.3 D-target 6 examples; notebook still never retrieved

hardware_constraints.overfit_threshold_observed: 154 examples x 3 epochs -> train 0.25 / eval plateau 2.86
